verdicts.reason: A shrinks the product to a tiny shoe stuck at the bottom, leaves the big peach circle empty, and squeezes the legal text into an unreadable six-line sliver next to the shoe. 'WEEKEND ONLY' has dropped below the subhead, the headline is small for the canvas, and the CTA floats alone in empty space, so the layout reads as scattered fragments. B keeps the shoe as the large hero over the circle and gives a clear headline → product → CTA → legal order. It still has flaws: 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits under the subhead instead of above the headline, the headline is undersized, the text block hugs the top-left while the CTA is centred so their axes don't line up, and the legal line is tiny.
